name: Slowpoke
look: The pink Pokémon Slowpoke, a sleepy-looking creature with a cream-colored snout, wide blank eyes and an open, dopey grin, stands on all fours with its curled pink tail raised behind it. The background is a pink and magenta pinwheel.
use: Mocks someone who is late to the news. The top text opens like a big announcement and the bottom reveals something everyone has known for ages, as if it just happened.
examples: Just found this cool new website
describe: pink pokemon with a dopey face on a pink background
slow pink creature with an open mouth and blank stare
derpy pink hippo looking cartoon for people late to the news
sleepy pink animal with a curly tail on a pinwheel background
meme for someone who just found out about old news
origin: Slowpoke is a Pokémon from the 1996 Game Boy games Pokémon Red and Green; the meme casts it as someone hearing news far too late.
